THE PIPE SHOP WAS PUMPING OIL FROM THE CGC CHINCOTEAGUE (WPB 1320) INTO A TANK ON THE PIER ON THE WEST WALL. THE TANK OVERFLOWED AND 5 GL OF THE PRODUCT WAS RELEASED INTO ARUNDEL COVE, A TRIBUTARY OF CURTIS CREEK. THE RESULTING SHEEN WAS 50' BY 25' AND THE FIREHOUSE CREW DROPPED ABSORBENT PADS & INTO THE WATER TO SOAK UP AS MUCH OIL AS THEY COULD CAPTURE. IT APPEARED THAT DUE TO WEATHER CONDITIONS (WIND NW AT 18 MPH & GUSTING TO 28 MPH), IT WOULD BE PRUDENT TO CALL IN A CONTRACTOR TO RECOVER THE SPILLED PRODUCT AND TO LIMIT THE SIZE OF THE SHEEN. MILLER ENVIRONMENTAL CALLED AT 1115.

THE MATERIALS THEN SPILLED INTO A STORM DRAIN.

properties.title: NRC Report: Process Wastewater in Private Sw Pond near Arlington, TX
properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 909889 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: GENERAL MOTORS
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 909889
Incident Time: 2009-06-24 14:00:00
Nearest City: Arlington, TX
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: PROCESS WASTEWATER
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: GENERAL MOTORS
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 10000 gallons
INITIAL INVESTIGATION SUGGESTS THAT AN OVERFLOW FROM A MIX TANK AT THE ONSITE WASTE WATER TREATMENT FACILITY WAS RELEASED TO THE STORM WATER DISCHARGE AT THE NORTH END OF THE FACILITY. THE RELEASE OF UNTREATED PROCESS WASTEWATER POSSIBLY INCLUDES SOME CONCENTRATION OF: PAINT SLUDGE, COOLING TOWER WATER AND ELPO; AND WE ARE CONDUCTING ANALYTICAL SAMPLING OF THE RELEASED MATERIAL TO CONFIRM OUR INITIAL ESTIMATION THAT NO RQS HAVE BEEN EXCEEDED. THE VOLUME RELEASED IS UNCERTAIN, BUT MAY HAVE APPROACHED SEVERAL THOUSAND GALLONS. THE RELEASE WAS LIKELY SIGNIFICANTLY DILUTED BY RAINFALL. THE SPILL HAS BEEN RELEASED THROUGH CONTACT WITH GROUND AND WATER, BOTH ON AND OFF OF GM PROPERTY. THERE IS VISUAL EVIDENCE OF THE RELEASE THROUGH UNDERGROUND STORMWATER PIPING AND OPEN CULVERTS FOR APPROXIMATELY 1/2 MI TO A SW RETENTION POND ON SIX FLAGS' PROPERTY. THERE IS NO STAINING ON THE POND'S SHORE OR OUTLET, AND NO FLOATING DEBRIS OR SHEEN. LOCAL REMEDIATION CONTRACTORS (EAGLE SWS) HAVE BEGUN CLEANING THE OPEN CULVERT DRAINAGE AREA TODAY, AND WILL CONTINUE CLEANING THE CULVERT AND UNDERGROUND PIPING FROM SIX FLAGS UPSTREAM TO THE GM PROPERTY.

Medium Affected: WATER

Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 5 feet by 10 feet (area 50 sq. ft.)
Reported Spill Volume: 2 gallons
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
ON 31AUG2011 A F/V CAUGHT FIRE WHILE FUELING IN FRIENDSHIP HARBOR, ME. THE VESSEL WAS A GASOLINE VESSEL. THE VESSEL WAS PUSHED AWAY FROM THE PIER WHILE ON FIRE TO PREVENT DAMAGE ASHORE. AFTER THE THE VESSEL BURNED TO THE FIBERGLASS HULL AND THE FRIENDSHIP FIRE DEPT. MADE ATTEMPTS TO PUT OUT THE FIRE THE VESSEL WAS MOORED AT A BOAT RAMP IN HATCHET COVE. AS THE TIDE RECEDED, THE VESSEL MADE CONTACT WITH THE SHORE AND LISTED TO THE STARBOARD SIDE. AS A RESULT THE VESSEL DISCHARGE LESS THAN 3 GALLONS OF HYDRAULIC OIL/GASOLINE INTO THE HARBOR. THE VESSEL HAD 45 GALLONS OF GASOLINE ON BOARD AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT.

Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
ON 31AUG2011 A F/V CAUGHT FIRE WHILE FUELING IN FRIENDSHIP HARBOR, ME. THE VESSEL WAS A GASOLINE VESSEL. THE VESSEL WAS PUSHED AWAY FROM THE PIER WHILE ON FIRE TO PREVENT DAMAGE ASHORE. AFTER THE THE VESSEL BURNED TO THE FIBERGLASS HULL AND THE FRIENDSHIP FIRE DEPT. MADE ATTEMPTS TO PUT OUT THE FIRE THE VESSEL WAS MOORED AT A BOAT RAMP IN HATCHET COVE. AS THE TIDE RECEDED, THE VESSEL MADE CONTACT WITH THE SHORE AND LISTED TO THE STARBOARD SIDE. AS A RESULT THE VESSEL DISCHARGE LESS THAN 3 GALLONS OF HYDRAULIC OIL/GASOLINE INTO THE HARBOR. THE VESSEL HAD 45 GALLONS OF GASOLINE ON BOARD AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT.
